content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) (Project Manager), 2 for Project Technical Support-III (Research Assistant) and 1 for Project Technical Support-III (Data Manager).

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) (Project Manager): Masters in social work or psychology or public health or M.Phil in Clinical Psychology/Psychiatric Social Work; Good command of Tamil and English. Project Technical Support III (Research Assistant): Three-year graduate degree in social work or psychology or public health or nursing + three years post qualification experience or Masters in social work or psychology or public health or nursing or M.Phil in Clinical Psychology/Psychiatric Social Work; Good command of Tamil and English. Project Technical Support III (Data Manager): Three-year graduate degree in social work or psychology or public health + three years post qualification experience or Masters in social work or psychology or public health or M.Phil in Clinical Psychology/Psychiatric Social Work; Experience in data management and data entry.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts. Age relaxation details are not provided in the extracted data. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) (Project Manager): Rs. 67200/- per month Project Technical Support III (Research Assistant): Rs. 33600/- per month Project Technical Support III (Data Manager): Rs. 33600/- per month

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Application Screening Written Test (60 MCQ) Certificate Verification Interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JIPMER Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JIPMER recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the JIPMER recruitment is 06 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this JIPMER recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced by JIPMER for various project-based positions, including Project Research Scientist - I, Project Technical Support-III (Research Assistant), and Project Technical Support-III (Data Manager).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Research Scientist - I post?
faq.answer: For the Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) (Project Manager) position, candidates must possess a Masters degree in social work, psychology, or public health, or an M.Phil in Clinical Psychology/Psychiatric Social Work. Good command of Tamil and English is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts in this JIPMER recruitment is 35 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the extracted information.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-III posts?
faq.answer: The Project Technical Support-III (Research Assistant) and Project Technical Support-III (Data Manager) posts offer a consolidated salary of Rs. 33600/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for these JIPMER positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these JIPMER positions involves an application screening, followed by a written test consisting of 60 MCQs. Candidates who clear the written test will proceed to certificate verification and an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the provided details for this JIPMER recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for the JIPMER recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for this JIPMER recruitment must be submitted via email. Candidates need to prepare their application with all necessary documents and send it to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the expected joining date after selection?
faq.answer: The expected joining date for the selected candidates in this JIPMER recruitment is 21 October 2026, following the announcement of results.
